title: Vasant Bhatt v. Kantilal Shah
text: This revision petition is filed by the tenant, Kantilal Shah, against the eviction decree under the Rajasthan Rent Control Act. The landlord, Vasant Bhatt, sought eviction on grounds of personal necessity and arrears of rent. The tenant contended that the landlord owns alternative accommodation and hence personal necessity is not established. The revisional court notes that the landlord's children have returned to the city after completing education and require the premises for residence. The alternative accommodation owned by the landlord is in a different locality and bona fide need is not negated by its existence. Arrears of rent of Rs 1,80,000 were also established. The protected tenant plea raised by the tenant was not substantiated by documentary evidence. The revision petition is dismissed. The eviction decree under the Rent Control Act is upheld. The tenant is given three months to vacate.
